_comment: Pinned bootstrap artifacts for scripts/tooling/stage_python_runtime.py (R11-03). Every download is checked against sha256 before use. CPython: the sha256 equals python.org's own published value (https://www.python.org/api/v2/downloads/release_file/?release=1110, checked 2026-10-06). pip: the wheel digest PyPI publishes (https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/26.2.1/json). The python version must equal requirements/environment-evidence.json's.
